reports.clinical: 73-year-old man referred for assessment of a lymphoproliferative disorder. No lymphadenopathy. Splenomegaly (spleen 16 cm on ultrasound). No B symptoms. Full blood count: Hb 85 g/L, WBC 6.3 x10^9/L, neutrophils 3.2 x10^9/L, platelets 208 x10^9/L; cytopenias noted. Monocytes 0.11 x10^9/L. Clonal B-cell count 2.8 x10^9/L.
reports.morphology: Peripheral blood film and bone marrow aspirate/trephine. Medium-sized lymphoid cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and circumferential villous projections (hairy cells) are present. The aspirate was a dry tap; the trephine shows increased reticulin fibrosis. An interstitial infiltrate of cells with clear cytoplasm and a fried-egg appearance is present. An intrasinusoidal pattern of infiltration is present in the trephine. Immunohistochemistry: annexin A1 positive, cyclin D1 positive. Reported by JM/RP, 02 Jun 2026.
reports.flow_cytometry: Flow cytometry, peripheral blood. Gating on CD19+ events (79% of lymphocytes). Clonal B cells are identified (kappa restricted) showing bright surface Ig. reports.cytogenetics: Conventional karyotype. Normal karyotype 46,XY[20]. Reported by JM/RP, 02 Jun 2026.
reports.molecular: Targeted NGS panel (lymphoid). BRAF p.V600E (c.1799T>A) detected (VAF 33%). No MAP2K1 mutation detected. Reported by JM/RP, 02 Jun 2026.
